title: Car camera
description: Live in-car video — the operator's browser connects straight to the vehicle's go2rtc (deploy/go2rtc/go2rtc.yaml); no video bytes cross NATS or land in the database. The panel's nominal timescale datasource satisfies the dashboard contract; it queries nothing.

list.name: camera
list.label: Camera (go2rtc) base URL
list.description: http://<vehicle-host>:1984 — the vehicle SBC's go2rtc API listener. Default is the bench vehicle; override here at the track, no dashboard edit needed.

options.content: This frame is the **vehicle's** go2rtc player, reached directly — telemetry does not pass through it and it does not pass through telemetry. The URL pins `mode=mse` deliberately: the stream is H.265, browsers will not take H.265 over WebRTC, and a default-mode player "succeeds" with a WebRTC session carrying **audio only** — a black frame with engine noise. Blank frame anyway: check `${camera}/` loads at all (go2rtc's own UI); if it does and this machine lacks hardware HEVC decode, open `${camera}/stream.html?src=car_h264` instead. Only one stream can hold the camera at a time — close other viewers before switching. Audio is muted by the browser until clicked.
